SQL_DOC.V_SQL:
SELECT IVHD.BUYER , IVHD.INV_NO , MAX(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD, ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMPODT PODT WHERE IVHD.BUYER = 'KRILJI0006' AND IVHD.SND_CHK = 'N' AND IVHD.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO= IVDT.INV_NO AND IVDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.PLANT IS NOT NULL AND PODT.PLANT IN ('1100') AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE = '0'
GROUP BY IVHD.BUYER , IVHD.INV_NO UNION ALL SELECT IVDT.BUYER , IVDT.INV_NO , MAX(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM WMSIVDT IVDT, ICOMPODT PODT WHERE IVDT.BUYER = 'KRILJI0006' AND IVDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND IVDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.PLANT IS NOT NULL AND PODT.PLANT IN ('1100') GROUP BY IVDT.BUYER , IVDT.INV_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT PODT.REF_IF_NO AS MANDT , IVDT.INV_NO AS INV_NO , IVDT.INV_SEQ AS INV_SEQ , PRDT.LEGACY_PO_NO , PRDT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , IVDT.INVOICE_DATE AS INV_DATE , PRDT.PLANT AS PLANT , PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , IVDT.INV_QTY , '' AS REMARK , DECODE(IVDT.STATUS,'D','D','C') AS STATUS , 'S' AS IF_FLAG , IVDT.ADD_DATE AS IF_DATE , IVDT.ADD_TIME AS IF_TIME FROM ICOMIVHD IVHD, ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT WHERE IVHD.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND IVHD.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND IVHD.SND_CHK = 'N' AND IVHD.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND IVHD.INV_NO= IVDT.INV_NO AND IVDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.PLANT IS NOT NULL AND PODT.PLANT IN ('1100') AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ= PRDT.PR_SEQ UNION ALL SELECT PODT.REF_IF_NO AS MANDT , IVDT.INV_NO AS INV_NO , IVDT.INV_SEQ AS INV_SEQ , PRDT.LEGACY_PO_NO , PRDT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , IVDT.INV_DATE AS INV_DATE , PRDT.PLANT AS PLANT , PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO , IVDT.INV_QTY , '' AS REMARK , DECODE(IVDT.STATUS,'D','D','C') AS STATUS , 'S' AS IF_FLAG , IVDT.ADD_DATE AS IF_DATE , IVDT.ADD_TIME AS IF_TIME FROM WMSIVDT IVDT, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT WHERE IVDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND IVDT.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$' AND IVDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND IVDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.PLANT IS NOT NULL AND PODT.PLANT IN ('1100') AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ= PRDT.PR_SEQ
DECLARE BEGIN IF '$G_RS.PROCESS_TYPE$' = '0' THEN UPDATE ICOMIVHD SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM= SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$'; ELSE UPDATE WMSIVDT SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM= SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$'; END IF; END;
